cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate (C5): Sodium Coco-Sulfate (2) is the defining alkyl-sulfate anionic, with at least two prominent buffers (Lauryl Glucoside 3, Coco-Glucoside 4, Disodium Cocoyl Glutamate 8, Sodium Cocoyl Glutamate 11) and no reinforcing strong anionic.
cleansingStrength.counterSignal: Alkyl sulfate is the harsher class, plus Maris Sal (5); no refatting.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Low: cleansing-led; the only care routes are three hydrolyzed proteins (13-15), Arginine (10) and a late cationic amino-acid conditioner PCA Ethyl Cocoyl Arginate (19). No cationic polymer, silicone, lipid or pearlizing route.
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: PCA Ethyl Cocoyl Arginate is an antistatic cationic and three proteins add some film; together they could give noticeable slip (neighbor moderate).

formulaFacts.role: plant juice, not a humectant route

weightPotential.rationale: Low: only hydrolyzed proteins and a late cationic arginate conditioner, facing a buffered coco-sulfate chassis; no polymer, silicone or lipid.
